$comment: The arcade ladder (Source/Content/Arcade.h). opponent: a fighter id, rival, mirror, or a list of them: the first who is playable, isn't the player and hasn't been met in this run. final: the title bout; boss: a bout after it against the named fighter, who is on no select screen. level: CPU level at NORMAL difficulty, 0 ROOKIE .. 4 CHAMPION; EASY plays one lower, HARD one higher.
